message.content: The local risks that remain even if a model does not send data to a cloud API include white box attacks, where the model provider may not be able to monitor the model during deployment and assess and mitigate privacy attacks on it. The model provider is less easily able to monitor the model during deployment and thereby assess and mitigate the risk of privacy attacks on it. However, the model provider remains responsible for assessing and mitigating the risk for genuine end users to know whether or not to rely on its output and will depend on the particular use case and context.
